const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Bookshelf instance 00 controller and episode record helper.
+
+The service owns the simulator; this script only uses the public RCB client.
+Each movement helper sends normalized 61-joint servo targets.  Keep all
+episode actions here so the run is reproducible from the recorded call list.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import os
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
+robot = Robot()
+spec = robot.spec()
+with open(os.path.join(OUT, "spec.json"), "w") as f:
+    json.dump(spec, f, indent=2)
+
+def observe(cameras=("room_camera",), depth=False):
+    return robot.get_obs(cameras=list(cameras), include_depth=depth, video="frames")
+
+def hold(target, steps, cameras=("room_camera",), note=""):
+    """Hold a 61-vector target for steps control ticks and return the response."""
+    a = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 61)
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.repeat(a, int(steps), axis=0),
+                        dt=spec["control_dt"], interpolate="hold",
+                        cameras=list(cameras), video="none", note=note)
+
+def ramp(target, steps, cameras=("room_camera",), note=""):
+    """Ramp to a 61-vector target over steps ticks."""
+    a = np.asarray(target, dtype=np.float32).reshape(1, 61)
+    return robot.submit("joint_position", a, dt=int(steps)*spec["control_dt"],
+                        interpolate="linear", cameras=list(cameras),
+                        video="none", note=note)
+
+def save_image(result, camera="room_camera", name="latest"):
+    from PIL import Image
+    Image.fromarray(result.last[camera]).save(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".png"))
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    result = observe()
+    save_image(result)
+    print(json.dumps(robot.status(), indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: /app/output/gen.py
@@
 def save_image(result, camera="room_camera", name="latest"):
@@
     Image.fromarray(result.last[camera]).save(os.path.join(OUT, name + ".png"))
+
+def normalized_radians(q, bounds):
+    lo, hi = bounds
+    return 2.0 * (float(q) - lo) / (hi - lo) - 1.0
+
+def start_pose_target(proprio=None):
+    """Reconstruct the observed starting pose as normalized servo targets."""
+    if proprio is None:
+        proprio = observe(("room_camera",)).meta["proprio"]["now"]
+    p = np.asarray(proprio, dtype=np.float64)
+    layout = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["layout"]
+    ranges = spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["range_rad"]
+    target = np.zeros(61, dtype=np.float32)
+    # The 21 body actuators map directly to proprioception entries 0..20.
+    for i in range(21):
+        target[i] = normalized_radians(p[i], ranges[i])
+    # Hand actuator order differs from proprio order.  Direct joints start at
+    # zero; each J0 tendon is fully open at its zero-radian lower limit.
+    pmap = {name: float(p[i]) for i, name in enumerate(spec["proprio"]["joints"])}
+    aliases = {
+        "lh_A_WRJ2":"lh_WRJ2", "lh_A_WRJ1":"lh_WRJ1",
+        "rh_A_WRJ2":"rh_WRJ2", "rh_A_WRJ1":"rh_WRJ1",
+    }
+    for i, name in enumerate(layout[21:], start=21):
+        clean = name.replace("_A_", "_")
+        clean = aliases.get(name, clean)
+        if clean.endswith("J0"):
+            q = 0.0
+        else:
+            q = pmap.get(clean, 0.0)
+        target[i] = normalized_radians(q, ranges[i])
+    return target
+
+def arm_hand_target(side="right", curl=-1.0, base=None):
+    """Set one hand's four finger flexor tendons while keeping other joints."""
+    target = start_pose_target() if base is None else np.array(base, dtype=np.float32, copy=True)
+    offset = 41 if side == "right" else 21
+    for i in (offset+9, offset+12, offset+15, offset+19):
+        target[i] = float(curl)
+    return target
*** End Patch";

steps.text: I found and corrected an actuator/proprioception ordering mismatch in my posture reconstruction: the right arm’s joint readings come after the left hand in the sensor vector. The first calibration had therefore sent the wrong right-arm targets. I’m restoring the measured joint posture now, then I’ll check the arm position and balance before continuing.
